guide.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.s: Base time: %s s · Base power: %s AE/t
gui.molecularmanipulator.dismantle_toolt: Click once to arm dismantling, then click again within 3 seconds. Rapid double-clicks are ignored.
gui.molecularmanipulator.dismantle_confi: Wait briefly, then click again to dismantle. Clicking elsewhere or waiting 3 seconds cancels.
gui.molecularmanipulator.pattern_search_: Searches pattern inputs and outputs. Just Enough Characters enables Pinyin matching when installed.
gui.molecularmanipulator.pattern_capacit: Encoded pattern slots currently in use.
gui.molecularmanipulator.sequence_batch_: Click processes 1 item; Shift-click processes up to 64.
gui.molecularmanipulator.sequence_decons: Click an item onto the left marker slot; the held item is not consumed. Once enabled, matching items are extracted only from ME, and the task waits when ME has none.
gui.molecularmanipulator.sequence_rewrit: Place one real item in the center sample slot before enabling copying. The sample is kept but must remain physically installed; removing or changing it stops copying.
gui.molecularmanipulator.rewrite_output_: Choose whether copied items enter ME or only the output slot. A full selected destination stops copying.
gui.molecularmanipulator.matter_target_t: Set the number to process before stopping. 0 means unlimited.
gui.molecularmanipulator.quantum_remote_: Target type: standard AE2 quantum ring
gui.molecularmanipulator.quantum_state.s: Local multiblock incomplete; remote ring not checked yet
gui.molecularmanipulator.quantum_state.c: Construction link stable; build-material extraction only
gui.molecularmanipulator.auto_craft_sele: Click a gear above, or right-click a dedicated pattern slot.
gui.molecularmanipulator.auto_craft_outp: Pauses when the primary output reaches this amount in ME. 0 is unlimited. Accepts values through Long.MAX_VALUE.
Output limit for %s. Pauses at this ME stock level; 0 is unlimited.
gui.molecularmanipulator.auto_craft_inpu: Auto crafting will not consume this logical ingredient below the configured amount. Substitutes are protected too.
Ingredient #%s · %s: amount that must remain in ME. Click Set or press Enter to submit.
gui.molecularmanipulator.visual_color_ad: Click to add 17; Ctrl-click for a fine step of 1; Shift-click to subtract.
message.molecularmanipulator.preview_leg: Block projection enabled: translucent models show the blocks to place, and red outlines mark conflicts. Click the button again to hide it.
message.molecularmanipulator.preview_cro: Not all chunks covered by the structure are loaded. One-click building waits until they are loaded.
message.molecularmanipulator.preview_bui: Outside dimension build limits: controller Y=%s needs %s blocks below and %s above, occupying Y=%s to %s; this dimension allows blocks at Y=%s to %s. Place the controller at Y=%s to %s. Empty sky can still be above the build limit.
message.molecularmanipulator.build_area_: Cannot start construction: not all covered chunks are loaded. Load the entire projected area and try again.
message.molecularmanipulator.build_alrea: The structure is already complete; no construction is required.
message.molecularmanipulator.build_repai: Preflight found only %s missing blocks. Switching to targeted repair.
message.molecularmanipulator.build_full_: Legacy remnants or block conflicts were detected. Running full calibration across %s positions.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_no: Matter rewriting requires a formed array with an active ME connection.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_in: Set the item to deconstruct in the left marker slot.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_bl: Place one output sample in the central blueprint slot.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_un: This operation is not enabled for the item in matter_rewrite_rules.json, or the item contains custom data.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_ou: The output slot cannot accept the rewritten matter.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_en: Rewrite entropy is saturated. Allow the array to cool before continuing.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_no: The ME network cannot supply enough energy for this rewrite.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_ca: Sequence storage is full, entropy is too high, or ME power is insufficient.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_in: Insufficient stored matter sequences for this sample.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_de: Deconstructed %s item(s) using the configured matter-sequence output.
message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_re: Rewrote %s item(s) from stored matter sequences.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.title: %s Configuration
molecularmanipulator.configuration.patte: Sets the number of pattern pages available to each Sequence Array. Each page contains 36 pattern slots. Range: 1-1000; default: 20.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.build: Maximum structure blocks placed or removed per tick. Higher values finish faster but increase instantaneous server load. Range: 1-256; default: 32.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.idle_: Idle power used by the Sequence Array controller while connected. Range: 1-4096 AE/t; default: 128 AE/t.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.matte: Per-Type Matter Sequence Capacity
Maximum amount stored independently for each Matter Sequence type. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 9223372036854775807 (the long-integer limit).
Rewrite Entropy Capacity
Maximum rewrite entropy held by a Sequence Array. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 1000000. Entropy/item is max(1, total/64) for deconstruction and max(1, total/16) for rewriting.
Entropy Cooling per Second
Base entropy removed from each Sequence Array per second, before applying the current speed-card cooling multiplier. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 25.
0 Speed Cards: Parallel Operations
Maximum items processed together per batch with 0 installed speed cards. Range: 1-4096; default: 1.
0 Speed Cards: Batch Time
Ticks between processing batches with 0 installed speed cards. Range: 1-1200; default: 20.
0 Speed Cards: Entropy Cooling Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the base entropy cooling rate with 0 installed speed cards. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 1.
1 Speed Card: Parallel Operations
Maximum items processed together per batch with 1 installed speed card. Range: 1-4096; default: 2.
1 Speed Card: Batch Time
Ticks between processing batches with 1 installed speed card. Range: 1-1200; default: 10.
1 Speed Card: Entropy Cooling Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the base entropy cooling rate with 1 installed speed card. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 2.
2 Speed Cards: Parallel Operations
Maximum items processed together per batch with 2 installed speed cards. Range: 1-4096; default: 4.
2 Speed Cards: Batch Time
Ticks between processing batches with 2 installed speed cards. Range: 1-1200; default: 5.
2 Speed Cards: Entropy Cooling Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the base entropy cooling rate with 2 installed speed cards. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 4.
3 Speed Cards: Parallel Operations
Maximum items processed together per batch with 3 installed speed cards. Range: 1-4096; default: 16.
3 Speed Cards: Batch Time
Ticks between processing batches with 3 installed speed cards. Range: 1-1200; default: 2.
3 Speed Cards: Entropy Cooling Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the base entropy cooling rate with 3 installed speed cards. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 16.
4 Speed Cards: Parallel Operations
Maximum items processed together per batch with 4 installed speed cards. Range: 1-4096; default: 64.
4 Speed Cards: Batch Time
Ticks between processing batches with 4 installed speed cards. Range: 1-1200; default: 1.
4 Speed Cards: Entropy Cooling Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the base entropy cooling rate with 4 installed speed cards. Range: 1-9223372036854775807; default: 64.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.omni_: Allows compatible providers to extract and dispatch multiple pattern crafts at once. Disabling this falls back to AE2 single-pattern dispatch. Enabled by default.
Emergency ceiling for complete one-recipe calls shared by an Omni-Computation Core per tick. The adaptive time slice normally stops much earlier. Range: 256-2147483647; default: 2147483647.
Maximum compatibility-dispatch time in microseconds shared by active Omni cores. It automatically shrinks as server MSPT approaches 45. Range: 250-50000; default: 20000.

Maximum work allowance per Omni-Computation Core and tick. One input extraction and each provider attempt cost one unit, regardless of batch quantity. Range: 64-9223372036854775807; default: 2147483647.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.matte: Matter Sequence Tooltip
Controls Matter Sequence information in item tooltips: DISABLED turns it off, HOLD_SHIFT expands it while Shift is held, and ALWAYS_VISIBLE keeps it visible. Default: HOLD_SHIFT.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.dynam: Client-side Molecular Center and Omni-Computation Core effects: 0=off, 1=reduced, 2=full orrery and quantum gate. This does not affect crafting speed.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.fixed: No expansion or upgrades; full capability when formed
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.build_tool: Only places missing blocks. Materials come from the player inventory first, then the connected AE network.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.dismantle_: Removes structure blocks in batches and keeps the controller. Recovered blocks go to the AE network first, then the player inventory.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.projection: Shows the actual expected block model at every exposed missing position. Click again to hide it. Red outlines indicate conflicts.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.refresh_to: Immediately checks every structure block and the AE network state.
gui.molecularmanipulator.structure_updat: Legacy 1.3.9: this version changes the building substantially. Open the structure projection to check it. Click, wait briefly, then click again to confirm within 5 seconds. Updating recovers the old structure and consumes materials for the new one.
Major layout changes: check the projection.
Keep the complete legacy layout unchanged. You can update it later.
message.molecularmanipulator.structure_u: This complete legacy structure is still supported. Choose whether to update it in the controller.
No complete legacy structure is available to update.
The AE network and player inventory are full. No structure blocks were changed.
message.molecularmanipulator.legacy_stru: The complete legacy 1.3.9 structure will remain in use. You can update it later from the controller.
message.molecularmanipulator.structure_u: Replacing the legacy structure: clearing the old layout and building the current structure.
Structure update complete. The legacy multiblock was replaced with the current layout.
The structure update stopped with %s conflicting positions. Conflicting blocks were preserved; clear them and use Build to finish.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.invali: The complete structure exceeds the build height. The current crown needs 17 buildable blocks below and 17 above its controller.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.chunks: Not all chunks covered by the structure are loaded.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.confli: %s conflicting blocks must be removed first.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.alread: The Omni-Computation Core is already formed.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.build_: The AE network and player inventory are full. Build migration stopped before removing the old center block.
The Omni-Computation Core is complete and initializing unlimited compute lanes.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.nothin: There are no Omni-Computation structure blocks to dismantle.
message.molecularmanipulator.omni.disman: The AE network and player inventory are full. Dismantling stopped safely.
The Omni-Computation structure was dismantled and the controller was preserved.
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.dis: Click once to arm dismantling, then click again within 3 seconds. The controller is preserved.
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.qua: Insert a paired Quantum Entangled Singularity to draw building materials from the remote ME network.
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.pat: Pattern assemblies join the controller grid; AE batch outputs return to the network first.
message.molecularmanipulator.fabrication: The Matter Fabrication Well is already formed.
%s conflicting blocks must be removed first.
The Matter Fabrication Well is complete and initializing its field.
There are no Matter Fabrication structure blocks to dismantle.
The Matter Fabrication structure was dismantled and the controller was preserved.
tooltip.molecularmanipulator.matter_fabr: Hold in either hand: cyan outlines mark sockets; replace the original structure block inside
Orange outlines mark occupied sockets; remove the existing block first
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.por: Right-click with a fluid container: pour in if filled, take out if empty. Left-click keeps the original transfer direction.
message.molecularmanipulator.controller_: Cannot move the controller: (%s, %s, %s) is occupied by an unrelated block, block entity or entity, or cannot be modified. Clear the target and retry Structure Update.
Controller relocation did not finish; the original controller data has been restored. Resolve the obstruction and retry Structure Update.
Controller relocation and rollback could not finish. Original data remains in the player recovery record; preserve the world and check the log for recovery details.
Controller relocation is waiting for a casing to fill the old ring socket or free recovery capacity. Supply it, then retry Structure Update.
This legacy controller position has an incomplete structure. Restore the original structure before confirming its update, or place a fresh empty controller for a new build.
message.molecularmanipulator.dismantle_l: The layout of these remaining blocks cannot be identified safely. Automatic dismantling was not started; restore the original structure before dismantling it.

gui.molecularmanipulator.research.jei_lo: Research unlock; depth boosts speed and parallelism
gui.molecularmanipulator.research.action: Meet the listed prerequisite completion counts to start. The full round cost is withdrawn from AE at the start. The first completion unlocks recipes; deep research improves production parallelism and speed. Pausing keeps materials and progress.
gui.molecularmanipulator.research.materi: Materials: live AE stock / still owed
gui.molecularmanipulator.research.cost_o: Material cost exceeds the long limit
gui.molecularmanipulator.research.refund: Waiting for AE to accept refunds
gui.molecularmanipulator.research.legacy: Resume to pay remaining legacy cost
gui.molecularmanipulator.research.max_hi: Maximum depth reached; production stays available
command.molecularmanipulator.research.no: Look at a Matter Fabrication Well Controller within 16 blocks, or append its coordinates to the command.
command.molecularmanipulator.research.un: Research does not exist or its required mod is unavailable: %s
Controller [%s]: all %s available research projects are now at maximum depth.
command.molecularmanipulator.research.se: Controller [%s]: research %s is now at %s/%s completions; its active attempt has ended.
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.por: Return this input cache to the controller AE network. Materials the network cannot accept remain in the cache.
Return this cache to the controller AE network.
Every 5 ticks, send cached materials to adjacent containers on enabled sides. Unaccepted materials stay in the cache.
%s: %s. Click to toggle. Multiple sides allowed; directions use world coordinates.
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.jei: Base duration and power are shown. Deep-research speed and parallel bonuses apply in the well.
The first completion unlocks this recipe. Prerequisite completion counts are configurable and default to one.
gui.molecularmanipulator.fabrication.buf: Return unprocessed inputs to AE. Full or offline networks leave them safely buffered. Active work keeps its materials.
